blocks.caption: A violet quill that hums with a promise

blocks.text: You may find one before you have ever heard of wings. A violet quill in a dusty chest, humming with a promise. Keep it. Someone, somewhere, still answers to it.
Summoning Feathers are found in loot chests, alongside the usual treasure, and never crafted. The chance depends on the dimension the chest is opened in.

Overworld and other dimensions: one chest in twenty (5 %).
Nether, including bastions and fortresses: one in ten (10 %).
End, including End Cities: one in five (20 %).
Each point of luck adds 2 % to that chance. A lucky chest always holds 1 to 3 feathers, never more, whatever your luck.
Chests of other mods count too, unless the server turns that off. With Lootr, every player rolls their own chest.
The Offering Fountain buys back what the altar gives you, and pays in feathers.
Feathers stack to 64. Carry them to the Draconic Altar: one feather for one summon, ten for ten.
